valley-bridge.name: Valley Bridge
valley-bridge.description: An old stone bridge crossing the silver river. Lanterns flicker each evening.

market-square.name: Market Square
market-square.description: Bustling market with stalls selling spices, trinkets, and rumors.

guild-hall.name: Guild Hall
guild-hall.description: A grand wooden building where merchants and artisans gather.

elara-swift.name: Elara Swift
elara-swift.backstory: I was a royal guard once. I left when my brother disappeared - finding him matters more than any oath.
elara-swift.personality: When I decide to act, I don't stop until it's done. I'd rather solve a problem than fight my way through it. Stray animals trust me - maybe because I know what it's like to be lost.
elara-swift.goal: Find my brother. He vanished near the river three weeks ago. Someone in this market knows something.

ronn-spice-merchant.name: Ronn Spice Merchant
ronn-spice-merchant.backstory: I've been selling spices in this market for thirty years. I know everyone, and everyone knows me. What they don't know is that I fund a small crew that rescues people from the Raiders.
ronn-spice-merchant.personality: I'm loud, I'm friendly, and I remember every face. Gossip flows through me like water - but the secrets that matter? Those I keep locked tight. My friends are family, and I protect family.
ronn-spice-merchant.goal: Keep my ears open for trouble. Help Elara find her brother if she asks - but the rescue crew stays secret unless there's no other choice.
knowledge: Kaelen Swift was last seen heading toward to meet the dockmaster Alan.
The dockmaster Alan has been acting suspiciously lately.

scarred-man-river.backstory: A grizzled man with a prominent scar across his face, known for asking about missing travelers near the river. He seems to be connected to the Marsh Raiders.

find-brother.title: The Missing Brother
find-brother.description: Find clues about the disappearance of Kaelen Swift, who vanished while on patrol near the river.

history: Elara stepped fully into Ronn’s shop, the scent of cinnamon and dried herbs immediately filling her nostrils. The market noise – a cacophony of bartering voices, clanging carts, and the occasional bleating goat – seemed to fade slightly within the confines of the small space. Ronn, meticulously arranging jars of saffron and peppercorns, glanced up with a guarded expression as she entered. A thin layer of dust coated his counter, suggesting he wasn't overly concerned with cleanliness or, perhaps, with attracting customers. He continued rearranging the spices, avoiding her gaze for a moment before offering a tight-lipped greeting. “Elara. What can I get for you?” His voice was low and measured, betraying an underlying tension. The air hung thick with unspoken questions, and Elara felt a prickle of unease as she noticed a scarred man lurking in the shadows near the back of the shop, watching them both intently.
